findingDetails.title: The bottom line's lift list names 4 of the 20 lift rows section 3 carries and does not say it is a selection
findingDetails.scopeProof: Inside the declared review target (research/research.md:38); cites the row census of section 3. No file outside the target modified.
findingDetails.case: A builder reads the bottom line, lifts the four named items, and ships without the 16 other lift rows section 3 carries, including 011's five and 006's four.
findingDetails.claim: Section 3 carries 20 lift rows across 12 phases; the bottom line names 4, each lift row 1 of its phase, and unlike the guards list beside it carries no selection label.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the four are a ranking, whether the guards list is labelled, and whether section 2 says anywhere that the list is a selection.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Section 2 is a summary and summaries select; the four may be the highest-value lifts.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None; the row census is exact and the four named items are lift row 1 of their phase in every case.
